title: MEGA: Multilingual Evaluation of Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of generative LLMs across 70 typologically diverse languages on 16 standard NLP benchmarks to quantify performance disparities between high-resource English and low-resource or non-Latin script languages.

Translating the Wino-MT dataset (which contains sentences balanced for male/female subjects and stereotypical/non-stereotypical roles) into 8 target languages, and calculating overall gender accuracy as well as F1 score differences between masculine vs. feminine and pro-stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical translations.
